source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Cayman Islands, residence

calendar.note: The Cayman Islands have no income tax or VAT. For US persons living there, estimated tax is due on 15 April, June, September and January, and the annual return on 15 June (automatic extension for those abroad; interest runs from 15 April).

sources.title: IRS: When to pay estimated tax

notes: The Cayman Islands levy no direct taxes: no income, corporation, capital gains, property, inheritance or gift tax. Government revenue comes from import duties, stamp duties and fees.
US persons abroad still file US returns (due 15 June for those living abroad, with extensions); use the US pack's estimate for the amount.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
